messages:
priya_csm: starting onboarding for Oceanic Labs. Goal: pilot Hosted search/chat integration and a stakeholder demo by end of month. Proposed kickoff Thu 11/16 10am PT. Agenda: intros, success criteria, access (SSO/API keys), sample data, infra sizing, enablement plan, procurement/legal risks. Who can make that slot?

sam_cs: I can run enablement & post-pilot feedback capture. 10am works.

oceanic_pm: PM + infra lead available. We'll upload a sanitized sample (ndjson) and top flows by Tue. Procurement asked for a rough cost estimate early.

jordy_se: I'll own SSO + ingestion. Need sample + example requests. Also please confirm log retention window.

kevin_eng: I'll scope Dedicated fallback and smoke tests. Planning perf runs on 1x and 2x configs; will post bench numbers in the doc.

mira_successops: Draft success criteria: p50 latency <300ms or documented tradeoff; top 6 user journeys validated in staging; stakeholder demo accepted; runbook + escalation path documented; procurement path noted.

priya_csm: Proposed high-level timeline: Week0 kickoff, Week1 access & sample, Week2 integration + enablement, Week3 pilot & feedback, Week4 demo & handoff. Flag any long lead items now (legal/procurement).

oceanic_pm: Legal wants a short retention note before sample upload; legal@oceanic.example is contact. Procurement wants PO ballpark by Week2.

jordy_se: Requesting Oceanic IP ranges for allowlist and a service account for uploads. Infra needs 48h lead time for allowlist changes.

kevin_eng: Will post bench template by EOD. Starting pilot config = 1 GPU-equivalent.

mira_successops: Feedback plan: 3-question pulse after pilot + 20-min stakeholder interview. I'll draft survey.

priya_csm: Action items: sam_cs create kickoff doc + invite; oceanic_pm upload sample + legal/procurement contacts; jordy_se SSO checklist + test creds; kevin_eng bench + smoke tests; mira_successops success criteria + survey; priya_csm risk register + 30/60 health checks.

calendar-bot: Meeting created: Thu Nov 16 10:00am PT "Oceanic Labs: Redwood Onboarding Kickoff"  invites sent. Link: https://meet.redwood/oceanic-kickoff

sam_cs: I'll add agenda + pre-reads to the doc. Please add owners before the meeting.

priya_csm: Thanks all  if procurement/legal windows look tight, flag here and we'll adapt timeline. See you Thu.
